description: The Settings window is local, bundled content (served via tauri://, never remote) and is the only window trusted with Tauri API access. It gets exactly the two app-defined commands (get_server_url/save_server_url, see src/lib.rs and build.rs) it needs to read and persist the server URL - both backed by the Store plugin on the Rust side. Do not widen this to the `main` window (see capabilities/default.json) or make it apply globally.
